messages:
Talia Morgan: opened a small PR to fix a few console observability docs + add an end-to-end example showing how traces include per-token cost. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/959 — would appreciate a quick pass on wording and the SDK snippets.
Ben Rivera: reading. can we avoid introducing new metric names? prefer reusing `redwood_token_cost_usd_total` for metrics and add `redwood.cost.token_usd` as the span attribute for traces so dashboards and traces align.
Ivy Sun: agree. added a short JS streaming snippet that demonstrates capturing latency and then showing the cost in the final meta. sample:```js
const stream = await redwood.chat.create({model: 'redwood-4', prompt, stream: true});
stream.on('data', chunk => { /* update latency chart */ });
const final = await stream.done(); // final.meta.token_cost contains cost
```
Talia Morgan: nice. I'm also adding a small migration note on the dashboard schema change (`panel.metrics` -> `panels[].metrics`) and a jq one-liner to remap labels. will include a before/after minimal JSON.
Ben Rivera: tiny nit: call out that metric labels moved under each metric's `label` field in the new schema. customers' dashboard imports will fail silently otherwise.
Ivy Sun: added a PromQL example for cost per model to drop into Grafana: `sum(rate(redwood_token_cost_usd_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(redwood_tokens_total[5m])) by (model)`. also included an Alertmanager receiver example for console incidents.
Talia Morgan: pushed updates — wording tweaks, jq snippet, JS snippet, PromQL example, and a one-line CI check that curls the preview and greps for `redwood.cost.token_usd`. docs-bot: preview build created: https://deploy-preview-959--docs.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:
preview-bot: sandbox available at https://sandbox-959.redwood-inference.internal — example trace endpoint `GET /example/trace` (Authorization header required).
Ben Rivera: LGTM aside from one more copy nit: change heading from "Cost attribution" to "Cost attribution (per route/model)" — clearer for customers.
Talia Morgan: done, pushed. planning to merge after one more review tomorrow morning. thanks! :rocket:
